name: Desert Refuge
body:
School abjuration; Level cleric/oracle 4, druid 2, ranger 3, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 action
Components V, S, M (a pinch of desert sand)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 24 hours
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

Desert refuge surrounds the target with an aura that maintains a constant temperature of 70 degrees Fahrenheit and protects him from the blazing heat of the day and the freezing cold of the night. It also shields the user from the effects of exposure to sun and wind, but not from objects propelled by the wind such as sand blown by a sandstorm.
